task: FA2 -- joint exposure and affected profiles: observation enumeration

conventions.domain: Fp2 observation = two base-field rows (re, im); Fp observation = one row
conventions.coefficient_provenance: every coefficient is a public function of (statement, proof bytes): drawn from the verifier transcript AFTER the commitment roots and the masked terminals are absorbed; the rank model conditions on the drawn values
conventions.status: executed = observed in FA1's retained log; source-derived = read from the pinned source, not captured; awaiting-capture = the Codex round-10 H / P3-W hook does not exist yet; outside-linear-model = not a linear functional of committed rows
conventions.no_zero_cost: an observation whose status is awaiting-capture or outside-linear-model is listed with its expected structure and is NOT counted as harmless

observations.role: group vector at tail(rho_f): the 7*nb_f f-planes g8,rg,a16,u16,ru,h16,rh (claims 0..7nb_f-1 of build_claims_zk_v3)
observations.domain: Fp2, n message entries (+ Q folded pad entries)
observations.base_rows_combined: rows_per_f_plane data rows per plane x 7 nb_f planes; mask a_mf[k] (one base row each)
observations.coefficients: lambda_k (pcs-group challenge, drawn in zk_rhos after the terminals) x (1-e_f) x eq_r(rho_f row bits) on data; lambda_k x e_f on mask a_mf[k]
observations.reuse: a_mf[k] also enters A.vec.prox (fresh rho) and A.value.zc20_term[k] (column weights); h16's data rows also enter A.vec.p5 under mask a_mdd
observations.status: executed (FA1 log: group of 7 at nb_f = 1)
observations.single_proof_verdict: vector alone: per-column hidden (7 base masks span Fp2); vector + 7 values: 2 base functionals of the seven planes leak (all-base multi-member rule)

observations.role: group vector at tail(rho_d): the 3*nb_d d-planes X,z,rd
observations.base_rows_combined: rows_per_d_plane rows per plane x 3 nb_d planes; masks a_md[k]
observations.coefficients: lambda_k (1-e_dz) eq_r(rho_d row bits); lambda_k e_dz on a_md[k]
observations.reuse: a_md[k] in A.vec.prox and A.value.zc17_term[k]; X's data rows also in A.vec.p2 under mask a_mgu
observations.single_proof_verdict: vector: hidden per column; vector + values: 2 base functionals of (X, z, rd) leak

observations.role: group vector at tail(p2 = r_i || r_kp): the nb_d X blocks (claim 10 at nb_d = 1)
observations.base_rows_combined: rows_per_d_plane X rows per block; mask a_mgu[c]
observations.coefficients: P1: lambda_c (1-e_gu) eq_r(p2 row bits), lambda_c e_gu; P3: both multiplied by (1-e_gu2)
observations.mask_support: a_mgu[0..nb_d), one base row per block
observations.reuse: a_mgu[c] in A.vec.prox and A.value.gu_term[c]; the X data rows are the same rows opened at rho_d
observations.status: executed at nb_d = 1 (T2: full plane; T32: one functional per column) -- FA1
observations.single_proof_verdict: nb_d = 1: n functionals (rows_per_d_plane rows each); nb_d >= 2: 2 base functionals of all X blocks

observations.role: group vector at tail(p5 = r_ip || r_k): the nb_f h16 blocks (claim 11 at nb_f = 1)
observations.base_rows_combined: rows_per_f_plane h16 rows per block; mask a_mdd[b]
observations.coefficients: P1: lambda_b (1-e_d) eq_r, lambda_b e_d; P3: x (1-e_d2)
observations.reuse: a_mdd[b] in A.vec.prox and A.value.d_term[b]; h16 rows also at rho_f under a_mf[7b+5]
observations.single_proof_verdict: nb_f = 1: n functionals; nb_f >= 2: 2 base functionals

observations.role: group vector at tail(rho_tab): the six multiplicity slots (claims 12..17)
observations.base_rows_combined: slot i: rows_i = max(size_i, n)/n rows of m and rows_i rows of mask, same eq row weights
observations.coefficients: lambda_i (1-e_tab) prod_{j<k_i}(1-rho_tab_j) eq_r; lambda_i e_tab prod(...) eq_r on the mask rows
observations.mask_support: each slot's same-shaped mask block; a slot spanning >= 2 rows is Fp2-effective per column
observations.reuse: mask blocks in A.vec.prox and A.value.tab_term[2i]
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered at log_n <= 15 (the INT16 slot spans >= 2 rows); at log_n = 16 all slots are one row and 2 functionals of the multiplicities leak

observations.role: FUNCTION 2 ONLY: group vector at tail(rho_p): z block of the predicate column (mask a_pmz) and the bit row a_pb (mask a_pmb)
observations.base_rows_combined: z block rows + the bit row; masks a_pmz, a_pmb (one base row each)
observations.coefficients: (1-e_p) with ext coefficient for the bit row; e_p on the masks
observations.reuse: both in A.vec.prox and in pred.term[0..2]; the z block is also opened at rho_d
observations.status: source-derived (no function-2 proof in FA1's run)
observations.single_proof_verdict: 2-member all-base group: 2 base functionals of (z block, the 16 slack bits) leak per function-2 proof

observations.role: proximity vector
observations.base_rows_combined: EVERY row of A (all data planes, all table rows, all mask rows, a_prox)
observations.coefficients: prox_rho[i], fresh Fp2 per row, drawn in zk_rhos after the lambdas and before any vector is absorbed
observations.mask_support: a_prox (only site of that row) + every mask row of A
observations.reuse: second appearance of every mask row
observations.status: executed (vector present in every FA1 opening; contents not analysed by the diagnostic)
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered per column in the joint model: a_prox supplies one of the two base dimensions, the other comes from the residual freedom of the multi-member groups' masks (numerically confirmed on all four layouts)

observations.role: terminal values: zc20_term[10b+i] (i<7), zc17_term[0..3nb_d), gu_term[0..nb_d), d_term[0..nb_f), tab_term[2i], pred.term
observations.base_rows_combined: the claim's data rows with (1-e) eq_r eq_col weights and its mask row(s) with e eq_col weights
observations.coefficients: column weights eq(point tail) x the claim coefficient pair; public
observations.reuse: third appearance of the mask row (vector, prox, value); for a group of m members only the lambda-combination of the values is implied by the vector -- the other m-1 values are independent observations
observations.status: executed (all terminals are in FA1's proofs; not used by the diagnostic)
observations.single_proof_verdict: this is the observation that makes every all-base multi-member group leak 2 base functionals

observations.role: folded pad coordinates v_g[n..n+Q) of every group vector and of the prox vector
observations.base_rows_combined: rho^T pads (rows x Q base unknowns)
observations.coefficients: the same rho as the message part
observations.mask_support: pads are fresh uniform per row
observations.reuse: the same pads enter the encoded sampled columns
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered by argument: determined by the message parts + sampled columns (the coset-encoding check is an identity), so they add no information beyond A.vec.*

observations.role: Q sampled encoded columns with salts and Merkle paths
observations.base_rows_combined: encoded[i][j*] = (f_row_i + Z_n g_pad_i)(coset point j*) for every row i
observations.coefficients: public encoding matrix at the sampled coset points; indices from challenge_indices (may repeat)
observations.mask_support: the Q pads of every row (Vandermonde on <= Q distinct coset points, Z_n != 0 there)
observations.reuse: pads also folded in A.pads
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered by argument for the linear part (pads are a bijection onto the sampled entries); unopened columns rest on the salted-leaf hash (computational assumption, outside the linear model)

observations.role: group vector at tail(rho_f): the 3 nb_f helper planes hg,hu,hh (Fp2-valued: re/im data rows)
observations.base_rows_combined: re and im rows of each helper plane; masks h_mf[k] = (re, im) pair
observations.coefficients: lambda_k (1-e_f) eq_r on re, x u on im; lambda_k e_f on mask re, x u on mask im
observations.reuse: masks in H.vec.prox and H.value.zc20_term[10b+7+i]; the helper data rows also enter H.vec.sum with coefficient (1, u)
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered in the linear model (vector + values Fp2-linear)

observations.role: group vector at tail(rho_d): the nb_d hz helper planes
observations.base_rows_combined: re/im rows of hz[c]; masks h_md[c] pairs
observations.coefficients: as H.vec.rho_f with e_dz
observations.reuse: masks in prox and zc17_term[3nb_d+c]; hz rows also in H.vec.sum
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered in the linear model

observations.role: group vector at rho_zs (a single-row point, whole point is the tail): the zero-sum row u masked by u'
observations.base_rows_combined: h_u (re, im), h_up (re, im)
observations.coefficients: lambda (1-e_zs) on u_re, x u on u_im; lambda e_zs on u'_re, x u on u'_im
observations.reuse: u also carries H.vec.sum; u' also in prox
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered (singleton with an Fp2 pair; value implied)

observations.role: group vector at tail(rho_tab): the six table helper slots h_t = m/(alpha - tval), Fp2-valued
observations.base_rows_combined: h_re, h_im rows of each slot; masks h_mre, h_mim blocks of the same shape
observations.coefficients: lambda_i (1-e_tab) ext_i eq_r on re, x u on im; e_tab ext_i eq_r on the mask blocks
observations.reuse: masks in prox and tab_term[2i+1]; table helper rows also in H.vec.sum with coefficient (-1, -u)
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered in the linear model

observations.role: the LogUp identity as one value-0 sum claim: all helper planes (+1, +u), all table helpers (-1, -u), the u row (+1, +u); empty point -> all-ones column weights
observations.base_rows_combined: every helper row, every table helper row, u_re, u_im
observations.coefficients: lambda (the group's single pcs-group challenge) x fixed +-1/+-u
observations.mask_support: ONLY the u pair, which is constrained: sum_j u_re[j] = sum_j u_im[j] = 0 (prove_layer_zk_v3 sets the last column to minus the sum)
observations.reuse: u also in H.vec.zsum (masked by u') and prox
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered BY ARGUMENT: u's 2(n-1) free base dims pad all but the cross-column functional sum_j v_sum[j], whose data part is the LogUp identity itself and whose value is the public claim value 0 (numerically confirmed on a 4- and an 8-column joint model)

observations.role: proximity vector
observations.base_rows_combined: every row of H
observations.coefficients: fresh prox_rho per row
observations.mask_support: h_prox (a single base row, not a pair) + all H mask rows
observations.reuse: second/third appearance of every H mask row
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered per column in the joint model (h_prox supplies one base dimension; the pair masks' residual freedom the other)

observations.role: terminal values zc20_term[10b+7..10b+10), zc17_term[3nb_d..4nb_d), zs_term, tab_term[2i+1]; the sum claim's value is the constant 0
observations.base_rows_combined: as the corresponding vectors with column weights
observations.coefficients: public
observations.reuse: third appearance of the pair masks
observations.single_proof_verdict: covered (Fp2-linear system: rank = obs - one identity per group)

observations.role: folded pads + Q sampled columns
observations.status: awaiting-capture (source-derived); same argument as A.pads / A.columns

observations.role: group vector at tail(p3 = r_kp || r_j): the 2 nb_d nb_f Wg and Wu blocks (build_w_zclaims_v3)
observations.base_rows_combined: rows_per_w_block rows per block; masks w_mgu[k] (one base row each)
observations.coefficients: lambda_k (1-e_gu2)(1-e_gu) eq_r(p3 row bits) on data; lambda_k e_gu2 on the mask
observations.reuse: masks in W3.vec.prox and W3.value.gu_term[nb_d+k]
observations.status: awaiting-capture (source-derived; C-2 hook proposed by FA1)
observations.single_proof_verdict: all-base group of 2 nb_d nb_f members: 2 base functionals of the Wg/Wu blocks leak (m = 2 at the tiny shape, 6 at 125M, 14 at 8B)

observations.role: group vector at tail(p6 = r_k || r_jp): the nb_d nb_f Wd blocks
observations.base_rows_combined: rows_per_w_block rows per block; masks w_mdd[k]
observations.coefficients: lambda_k (1-e_d2)(1-e_d) eq_r; lambda_k e_d2 on the mask
observations.reuse: masks in prox and d_term[nb_f+k]
observations.single_proof_verdict: nb_d nb_f = 1: SINGLETON with one base mask -> w_n functionals of the Wd block per proof (the whole block at T32/log_cols 8 where the block is one row; 8-row functionals at T2/log_cols 5); otherwise 2 base functionals

observations.role: proximity vector
observations.base_rows_combined: every W row (3 nb_d nb_f blocks x rows_per_w_block, the 3 nb_d nb_f masks, w_prox)
observations.coefficients: fresh prox_rho per row
observations.reuse: second appearance of every W mask
observations.single_proof_verdict: nb_d nb_f = 1: NOT covered -- 4 mask rows vs 6 base observation dims per column: after the p6 singleton pins w_mdd and the p3 vector pins (w_mgu[0], w_mgu[1]) up to the data, the prox has only w_prox's one dimension -> one extra base functional of (Wg[j], Wu[j]) per column (numerically confirmed); nb_d nb_f >= 3: covered

observations.role: gu_term[nb_d..], d_term[nb_f..]: the masked W block terminals
observations.single_proof_verdict: the observation behind the 2-functional leak of the p3 and p6 groups

observations.role: plain (non-hiding) opening of public weights
observations.status: n/a: no privacy claim on W under P1

observations.commitment: M (the CFS mask commitment for the six/seven sumchecks)
observations.role: masked sumcheck round polynomials, masked claimed sums (gu_claim, d_claim, gamma*), the mask functionals opened by mask_open (eval at rho, hypercube sums), the M proximity combination and MASK_Q sampled columns
observations.base_rows_combined: the CFS mask polynomials' coefficient rows -- NOT A/H/W rows
observations.coefficients: theta, r_row, sampled indices

observations.role: the verifier's terminal checks (e.g. want = sum gu_term[c] * sel * sum lam_f wg...) tie the masked terminals of different commitments together
observations.single_proof_verdict: public checks on already-public values; add no new observation (each equation is implied by the terminals it uses)

repeated_proof_observations.mechanism: each proof redraws every challenge; a data row present in R proofs is observed under R independent coefficient sets, and the disclosed functionals accumulate
repeated_proof_observations.singleton_roles: R proofs recover an R-row plane linearly
repeated_proof_observations.P3_weights: identical across proofs by construction: at nb_d nb_f = 1 two proofs recover Wg, Wu, Wd in the linear model; at 125M/8B 4 functionals per proof
repeated_proof_observations.activations: accumulate only when the same X is re-proven
